topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture, providing the overarching framework and outlining key learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic Clonal Succession and Epigenetic Alterations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how successive genetic mutations drive Darwinian clonal selection and how non-mutational epigenetic alterations can similarly facilitate cancer development.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the hierarchical organization of tissues and experimental evidence for cancer stem cells initiating and propagating malignancies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Stromal Dependency
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate that external promoters, chronic inflammation, and supportive stromal interactions are essential to license and sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Techniques for Investigating Tumors and Multi-Factorial Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe modern experimental technologies for studying tumor heterogeneity and synthesize the combined genetic, cellular, and microenvironmental factors driving cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic marks the conclusion of the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on cancer therapy.
